engineDescPro: GPT-5-class reasoning translation — 70+ spoken languages into 13.
engineDescPremium: Auto-detects 2000+ language pairs and preserves your tone, pitch and intonation.
engineDescEnhanced: Real-time subtitles in 60+ languages, streamed straight to your browser for the lowest latency.

engineCostPerLanguage: Rate is per translation language — a group call with more languages costs more.
engineCostPerSource: Rate is per source you listen to — hearing more people at once costs more.

onbHomeWelcomeBody: Talk with anyone, in any language. Your speech becomes live subtitles and a translated voice — in real time, on every call.
onbHomeStartBody: Set your name and language, then enter a room code to open a room or join a friend's. Hit Connect and you're in.
onbHomeTiersBody: Standard gives you live subtitles and a translated voice on a budget. Higher tiers translate faster and more accurately. Switch any time before a call.
onbHomeCreditsBody: Calls draw from your balance by the minute, per translation language. Top up any time with Buy credits — your balance always shows up top.
onbHomeGuestTitle: Sign in to save your history
onbHomeGuestBody: Start talking as a guest right now. Sign in to keep your call history, transcripts and credits across devices.
onbHomeCtaBody: That's the tour. Set your language, pick a room and say hello. Reopen this guide any time from the "?" button.
onbCallIntroBody: Here's a quick tour of your controls. You can skip any time.
onbCallMicBody: Mute and unmute yourself. When you speak, your words are transcribed and translated for everyone.
onbCallCamBody: Turn your camera on or off. Your audio keeps flowing either way.
onbCallCaptionsBody: Show or hide translated captions over the video.
onbCallVoiceBody: Turn the spoken translation on or off. Leave it on to hear everyone in your language.
onbCallChatBody: Message the room. Everything you type is auto-translated for each person.
onbCallRoomBody: This shows your room code and the language you're hearing. Tap the code to copy and share it.
onbCallMoreBody: Screen share, recording, whiteboard, reactions and more live in here.
onbCallShareBody: Present a window or your whole screen to the room without leaving the call.
onbCallInviteBody: Copy an invite link or send it by email to bring others in.
onbCallLeaveBody: Hang up when you're done. You'll get a summary with transcripts and downloads.
onbCallDoneBody: Reopen this tour any time from the "?" button. Enjoy the conversation.
scheduleCancelConfirm: Cancel this meeting? The attendees will be notified.
scheduleErrRequired: Title and start time are required.
scheduleConnectCalendar: Sign in again to connect your Google Calendar.
